entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout has an invalid sample schema
entries.rationale: canonicalizeMixedFloatArmForAgg, lowerMixedExpHistogramOperands, and widenPlainVectorToMixedShape all reject kinds outside Float or Float/Mixed before calling this helper, excluding SampleKindInvalid. legacySampleProjectionLayout consumes only successful PromQL lowerer outputs and treats failure as an assertion panic. A wire query cannot construct an invalid Schema directly.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout metric-name role requires a timestamp role
entries.rationale: canonical sample constructors publish MetricName and Timestamp together; reduced RangeWindow outputs omit MetricName as well as a per-row timestamp, while mixed VectorSetOp schemas require and publish both. The forwarding adapters preserve those roles. Therefore a metric-name role without a timestamp role can only be produced by malformed internal plan construction.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout is missing the attributes role
entries.rationale: every production input to the four callers is a successful PromQL vector producer: sample, VectorSetOp, and RangeWindow constructors all publish a named Attributes role, and mixed schemas require it. Queries cannot author plan schemas, so a missing role denotes an internal producer-contract violation.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout is missing the value role
entries.rationale: SampleKindFloat and SampleKindMixed require a unique named Value role, and the three error-returning callers admit only those kinds before invoking this helper. legacySampleProjectionLayout likewise receives successful sample-producing plans. A missing Value can therefore arise only from malformed internal construction.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout requires a closed schema
entries.rationale: an open schema classifies as SampleKindOpaque, so the three error-returning callers' Float or Float/Mixed preconditions exclude it. legacySampleProjectionLayout is an assertion adapter used only after ordinary PromQL lowering has produced a closed sample/window schema. No wire query can supply an open Schema to these callers.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: temporal sample layout anchor role requires a timestamp role
entries.rationale: matrix RangeWindow and grid constructors append Anchor and Timestamp roles together, while canonical and reduced sample producers publish neither an orphan anchor nor a partial envelope; forwarding wrappers preserve both roles. An anchor without timestamp therefore signals malformed internal plan construction.
